lead: A switch whose behaviour comes from Base UI's Switch. Its structure and state conventions match [Checkbox](/checkbox). The examples follow the Switch page of the HeroUI docs.

with-description.title: With Description
with-description.sample: Receive alerts when someone mentions you.

without-label.title: Without Label
without-label.description: Without text, give the control an `aria-label`.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `switch.css`. The thumb slides to the other end with `margin`; the track and thumb sizes come from the size step.
styling.slot: Structure hooks: `switch` is the outer `<label>`, `switch-control` the track, `switch-thumb` the thumb
styling.states: State hooks, written on `switch-control` and `switch-thumb`; theme styles read changes of the whole label with `:has()`
